chunks: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah all affairs will be returned.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Allah's ownership of the heavens and the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hadid underscores Allah's absolute dominion (Mulik) over the cosmos, serving as a foundation for understanding divine authority that extends to the Imams as His representatives. It highlights the ultimate return (Irad) to God, reinforcing the concept of accountability and the transient nature of worldly power compared to eternal divine judgment.
